records.preparation: Mix the full packaged powder quantity according to the instructions supplied with the product; Kodak does not recommend mixing less than the package volume.
records.capacityText: Kodak's B&W chemistry matrix lists useful tank capacity as 16 per US gallon / 4 per litre for D-76.
records.shelfLifeStock: Full-strength stock in a full closed container: 6 months without use.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Kodak matrix lists approximately 24 hours in an open tray and 1 month in a tank for full-strength solution; diluted 1+1 reuse is not recommended by the matrix.
records.sourceTitle: Chemicals for KODAK PROFESSIONAL Black-and-White Films, E103CF

records.preparation: Dilute ILFOTEC DD Developer 1+4 and use with ILFOTEC DD Starter according to the replenished processor instructions.
records.reuseInstructions: Designed for dip-and-dunk replenished processors and used with ILFOTEC DD Starter; the chemistry is replenished and is formulated for long tank life and resistance to contamination.
records.sourceTitle: ILFORD Introduction to Film Developers / ILFOTEC DD

records.preparation: Dilute the liquid concentrate immediately before use. Standard working dilution is 1+39; the manufacturer sheet allows approximately 1+19 to 1+59 depending on the film and desired result.
records.reuseInstructions: The diluted working solution must not be reused and is discarded after development.
records.capacityText: Up to 40 films per 300 ml of concentrate. For high dilutions use at least 6 ml concentrate per 135 or 120 film.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Use concentrate within 6 months after opening; minimize air in the bottle or use inert gas.

records.preparation: Prepare a one-shot working solution from the concentrate; the standard dilution is 1+100, with higher dilutions up to about 1+500 possible for economy and longer development times.
records.reuseInstructions: Designed as a one-shot film developer; discard working solution after use.
records.capacityText: A 100 ml bottle develops approximately 30-100 rolls of 35 mm film, depending on dilution and working volume.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Opened concentrate: more than 6 years according to Zone Imaging.

records.preparation: For the 135 ml format, mix 135 ml concentrate with 165 ml water to make 300 ml ready-to-use solution; the 500 ml package can be mixed with 500 ml water to make one litre.
records.reuseInstructions: Working solution can be reused for a limited period/capacity according to package size and storage conditions.
records.capacityText: 135 ml package makes 300 ml working solution for at least 2 rolls; when stored accurately the same working solution may process up to 3-4 rolls. The 500 ml package makes 1 litre and the current product page states up to 8 rolls within two weeks.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Opened concentrate: use within 1 month; life may be extended to 8-12 months if air is successfully removed and the concentrate is stored properly.
records.shelfLifeWorking: 135 ml working solution: use within 5 days; the current 500 ml product formulation states reuse within two weeks.
